title: Hue Amazing Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Hue Amazing Marathon 2026 Review | Hue, Vietnam
meta_description: Hue Amazing Marathon 2026 review: 4,500+ runners from Phu Van Lau on 30 August, a 3am run past the Imperial City and over three bridges, cool conditions.
dek: Hue's heritage marathon started in the dark in front of Phu Van Lau on 30 August 2026, with more than 4,500 runners. Here is what it was like, from the report on it.
verdict: The Hue Amazing Marathon sells itself on the city, and the 2026 edition delivered on that. More than 4,500 runners gathered from 2.30am at the square in front of Phu Van Lau and the Flag Tower, with a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km [1]. The route ran past the Imperial City in the dark and crossed three of Hue's bridges, including the 125-year-old Truong Tien Bridge [1]. Conditions were reported as cool, with a breeze off the Perfume River [1], and runners interviewed praised both the course and the organisation [1]. If you want a marathon that doubles as a tour of Vietnam's old imperial capital,, this is a strong choice.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The race was held on 30 August 2026, organised by Bolt Event with Red Tiger as partner, over four distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km [1]. More than 4,500 runners took part [1].

Runners started gathering at 2.30am at the square in front of Phu Van Lau and the Flag Tower (Ky Dai), by the Perfume River [1]. The marathon went first, and the half marathon started at 4am, as dawn was coming up [1].

sections.heading: The Route: the Imperial City and Three Bridges
paragraphs: The marathon's early start meant running past the Imperial City at 3am, and several runners said they wanted to slow down to take in the view even while chasing a personal best [1]. Runners crossed three bridges: the Da Vien Bridge, the 125-year-old Truong Tien Bridge, the symbol of Hue, and the new, wide Nguyen Hoang Bridge [1].
The report describes cool weather and a breeze off the Perfume River [1]. Don't count on that every year: late August in central Vietnam can be hot and humid.

sections.heading: What Runners Said
paragraphs: A couple from a running club in Gia Lai who ran the 10 km together while on holiday said the route and scenery were beautiful and the organisation was very good [1]. The women's marathon winner, Le Thi Phuong, said she fell near Thien Mu Pagoda and got up to keep running [1].
Japan's Shohei Myamoto won the men's marathon, ahead of Nguyen Mai Trung and Nguyen Tien Toan, and Vu Dinh Duan won the men's half marathon [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a destination race in Vietnam where the course is the reason to go. Running past an imperial citadel and across a 125-year-old bridge before sunrise is the point of this race.
Plan for a very early start and a humid morning, even if 2026 was kind. Watch your footing on the darker sections of the course.
This review is compiled from a published report on the 2026 edition, including runners' comments given to the reporter. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Hue Amazing Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: More than 4,500 runners took part on 30 August 2026 across the 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km. The race is organised by Bolt Event, with Red Tiger as partner, and starts from the square in front of Phu Van Lau and the Flag Tower in Hue.

faqs.question: What time does the Hue Amazing Marathon start?
faqs.answer: Very early. In 2026 runners gathered from 2.30am, the marathon started first and ran past the Imperial City around 3am, and the half marathon started at 4am as dawn was breaking.

faqs.question: What is the Hue Amazing Marathon route like?
faqs.answer: A tour of the old imperial capital. In 2026 it passed the Imperial City and crossed three bridges over the Perfume River: the Da Vien Bridge, the 125-year-old Truong Tien Bridge and the modern Nguyen Hoang Bridge. The day was reported as cool, with a river breeze.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the 2026 edition, run on 30 August. Replaces a pre-race preview. The pull quote is a participant speaking to a reporter. No rating: comments from a handful of runners in one report are not enough to score an event.
